label: First copy step (input = first original token, right after <DEL>) in length-9 sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely (98% of mass) at the step right after <DEL>, where the input is orig(0) fed back and the output is orig(1). It is strongly length-gated: 96% of mass comes from L=9 (t=10) and about 4% from L=8 (t=9, weak). Within L=9 it fires on about 72% of sequences. Magnitude depends on the identity of the first token: l and z give the largest activations, c, w, n, b, i come next, and the first tokens in false positives (u, m, h, r, x, y, d, j) give little or nothing. A small tail fires at recall_idx 2 (t=11), usually weakly. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, on shorter sequences (L<=7), or later in the copy phase. Excluding the weak first tokens did not improve F1, so the token dependence is graded, not a clean set.
